query:
SELECT c.id, c.sectionType, c.content, c.orderIndex 
FROM content_sections c
JOIN scraped_pages p ON c.pageId = p.id
WHERE p.jobId = 90005
ORDER BY c.pageId, c.orderIndex
LIMIT 20;
